title: 第7章 领赏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林珝一直没动，但手心已经攥出了汗水。

沈哥把食盒递过来说，“折腾一晚，趁热吃吧。”

“谢谢沈哥。”他直起身，真心实意道了声谢。

看得出，沈哥是专程来给自己的解围的。

沈哥摆了摆手，转身要走，却又停住，回头看了林珝一眼。

那眼神里有审视，有考量，还有一些让人分辨不清的意味。

“林珝，其实我佩服你老爹。”

林珝愣住，默默抬起头。

“附近几十里的山头，你爹林黑虎，是第一个敢站出来跟乌勒人硬碰硬的。”

沈哥顿了顿，语气难得地放缓了几分，“我也是穷苦出身，所以对他一直很敬重。”

林珝没接话，静静等着下文。

“但眼下的情况你也知道。”

沈哥收回目光，声音重新变得沉稳，“昨晚你能活下来，靠的是运气活。”

但要想在这个吃人的地方活下来，光靠运气是不够的。

他顿了顿，语气里多了一层说不清的意味。

“除了运气，还得拿出能证明你价值的东西。”

林珝坐在床边，把那句话在脑子里翻来覆去嚼了几遍。

然后他抬起头，看向窗外渐亮的天色。

沈哥的提醒，让他彻底做实了自己的判断。

自己必须尽快拿出在山寨立足的能力，否则，要么是死在疤哥那几个兄弟手上。

要么还和之前一样，当一辈子囚徒。

两个时辰后，山寨来人了。

这次沈哥带来了七八个人，让林珝负责带路，去昨晚遭遇乌勒斥候的地方。

林珝凭着记忆往林子里走，来到那片松木林，尸体还在原地。

疤哥面朝下趴在一丛枯草里，一支弩矢从后背贯入，穿透胸腔，箭头带着凝固发黑的血从前胸炸出来。

小喽啰的情况更惨，被三个斥候围上来乱刀砍死，五官都变了样，血腥味经过一夜的晾晒变得更加难闻。

同来的喽啰们站了一圈，没人说话。

“这些该死的乌勒狗……”

一个年轻的山寨喽啰低声咒骂，语气充满了恨意。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Jue didn't move, but her palms were already sweating.

Brother Shen handed over the food box and said, "Try it all night and eat it while it's hot."

"Thank you, Brother Shen." He straightened up and thanked him sincerely.

It can be seen that Brother Shen came here specially to rescue himself.

Brother Shen waved his hand and turned to leave, but stopped and looked back at Lin Sui.

There was scrutiny, consideration, and some incomprehensible meaning in those eyes.

"Lin Jue, actually I admire your dad."

Lin Jue was stunned and silently raised his head.

"On the top of the nearby mountains dozens of miles away, your father Lin Heihu was the first one who dared to stand up and confront the Ule people head-on."

Brother Shen paused, and his tone rarely slowed down a bit, "I also came from a poor background, so I have always respected him."

Lin Jue didn't answer and waited quietly for the next sentence.

"But you also know the current situation."

Brother Shen looked away and his voice became calm again, "You survived last night because of luck."

But if you want to survive in this cannibalistic place, luck alone is not enough.

He paused, and there was an indescribable meaning in his tone.

“In addition to luck, you have to come up with something that proves your worth.”

Lin Jue sat on the edge of the bed and chewed that sentence over and over in her mind.

Then he raised his head and looked out the window at the brightening sky.

Brother Shen's reminder made him completely confirm his judgment.

He must show his ability to gain a foothold in the village as soon as possible, otherwise, he will either die at the hands of Brother Scar and his brothers.

Or stay as before and be a prisoner for the rest of your life.

Two hours later, someone came from the cottage.

This time Brother Shen brought seven or eight people and asked Lin Jue to lead the way to the place where he encountered the Ule scout last night.

Lin Jue walked into the forest based on his memory and came to the pine forest. The body was still there.

Brother Scar was lying face down in a clump of withered grass. A crossbow arrow penetrated from his back and penetrated his chest. The arrowhead exploded out of his chest with blood that had solidified and turned black.

The situation of the young minions was even worse. Three scouts surrounded him and hacked him to death. His facial features were changed, and the smell of blood became even more unpleasant after being left to dry overnight.

The fellow gangsters stood in a circle, but no one said anything.

"These damn uller dogs..."

A young copycat man cursed in a low voice, his tone full of hatred.
